column3: The Yatton Demoniac
column5: In 1788, a tailor from Yatton became the center of a notorious national sensation after claiming to be possessed by seven demons for eighteen years. Following a public appeal, he was taken to the vestry of Temple Church in Bristol where an exorcism successfully cast out the evil spirits.

column3: The Vienna Possession of 1583
column5: A sixteen-year-old girl underwent extensive exorcisms at a Jesuit chapel in Vienna after allegedly being possessed by more than 12, 000 demons. Following the extraction of the entities, her grandmother was accused of witchcraft, tortured, and executed

column3: The Possession at Spanjaardstraat
column5: During a 19th-century spiritualist investigation at a historic house in Bruges, a visiting medium was violently possessed by the earthbound entity of a 15th-century monk. The possessing spirit re-enacted a heinous murder he had committed centuries prior within the building's walls.

column3: The Mass Possession Panic at Big Falls School
column5: In May 2007, a wave of violent and inexplicable possession episodes struck students and teachers at a village primary school in southern Belize, forcing its closure and specialized spiritual intervention.

column3: The Possession of José in San Pedro Cave
column5: In February 1991, a young boy named José became possessed by a malevolent entity after exploring a forbidden cave on Cerro San Pedro in Oruro, Bolivia, leading to a harrowing, multi-hour exorcism.

column3: The Possession of Barbe Hallay
column5: In 1660 New France, a teenage girl named Barbe Hallay was allegedly possessed by demons and tormented by hellish spectres after a rejected suitor sought revenge through sorcery. Plagued by violent outbursts and foreign voices, she was later subjected to years of intense exorcisms by nuns at a Quebec hospital.

column3: The Mass Possession of Nóvita
column5: Twenty-two schoolgirls in Colombia suffered violent seizures, hallucinations, and apparent demonic possession after playing the "Charlie Charlie" pencil game. Rushed to a local medical center foaming at the mouth, the victims described terrifying visions of a menacing man dressed in black.

column3: The Possession of Remedios
column5: In 1682, the parish priest of Remedios documented that a local woman named Leonarda was possessed by Lucifer, who spoke through her during formal ecclesiastical proceedings. The resulting panic prompted unsuccessful attempts by church authorities to relocate the entire town.

column3: The Køge House Cross
column5: Between 1608 and 1615, a wealthy merchant's household in Denmark endured years of demonic haunting and spirit possession that culminated in a devastating witch trial.

column3: The Exorcism of Teresa on Moqattam Hill
column5: During a public Thursday evening service, a young woman named Teresa was brought before Father Samaan Ibrahim to be freed from multiple demons that had taken possession of her body.

column3: The Exorcism of the Young Student at Santo Tomás Church
column5: Father Raymundo Brizuela performed a grueling exorcism at Santo Tomás Church on a 21-year-old university student from Chalatenango who was taken over by an entity that altered her voice and required multiple priests and men to restrain her.

column3: The Demonic Fall of St. Olaf's Builder
column5: During the construction of St. Olaf's Church in st, a mysterious master builder plunged to his death from the spire, after which a snake and a toad crawled from his mouth as proof of his diabolical possession.

column3: The Spirit Possession at Nacavanadi Church
column5: During a prayer service in an island village, a congregant became possessed by a spirit that falsely accused a local homeowner of practicing witchcraft. Prompted by the entity's claims, the minister and villagers destroyed the targeted house, leading to a landmark court ruling against the church.

column3: The Demonic Possession of the Ursuline Nuns of Loudun
column5: In 1632, an entire community of Ursuline nuns at a convent in Loudun, France, fell victim to violent mass demonic possession, allegedly orchestrated by a local parish priest. The ensuing public exorcisms and witchcraft trials gripped the region and ended in a tragic execution.

column3: The Jinneh Possession Outbreak at Ming Daw School
column5: Dozens of teenage students at a Gambian secondary school were suddenly overtaken by malevolent spirits, exhibiting violent convulsions and unnatural superhuman strength.

column3: The Exorcism of the Student at the Monastery of Saint Gerasimos
column5: A seventeen-year-old student afflicted by an unclean spirit was brought to a historic island monastery in Greece where he was successfully exorcised before the relics of a revered ascetic. The account was documented in a mid-twentieth-century Greek newspaper.

column3: The Fróðá Wonders
column5: Following the death of a traveler who left forbidden bed linen at an isolated farm, a terrifying wave of fatal hauntings and a supernaturally animated seal terrorized the household. The malevolent entities were finally banished when a priest conducted formal door-doom exorcisms and burned the cursed textiles.

column3: The Possessed Novices of Lucedio
column5: During a medieval gathering of witches, the Devil possessed the young novices of a nearby convent and used them to corrupt the monks of the Principato di Lucedio into a century of dark rituals.

column3: The Awakening at Oberlin High
column5: During a morning devotion led by a teacher warning that God was displeased, multiple students at a Jamaican high school suddenly collapsed, spoke in strange voices, and exhibited signs of demonic possession that required fervent spiritual deliverance.

column3: Otora Gitsune
column5: A one-eyed, three-legged fox spirit named Otora Gitsune possessed numerous villagers in Japan, starting with a young woman named Otora. Victims exhibited strange physical ailments and endlessly recounted battle memories they never experienced until the spirit was eventually slain by a hunter.

column3: The Possession of Mr Gopal
column5: During a 2015 paranormal investigation at an unfinished colonial mansion in Malaysia, a visitor was suddenly taken over by the spirit of a disgruntled historical worker. The entity spoke through the participant in English, recounting his unfulfilled promises and deep resentment.

column3: The Mass Exorcisms of Saharna Monastery
column5: During weekly midnight services at a historic monastery in rural Moldova, dozens of young people and villagers gather to undergo intense exorcisms to purge themselves of alleged demonic possession.

column3: The Court of the Jinn King
column5: Afflicted by invisible spirits and severe spiritual possession, troubled individuals are brought to a sacred mountain shrine in the High Atlas Mountains to face the supreme jinn judge for deliverance. According to Moroccan folklore, those overtaken by jinn must submit to spiritual trials and rituals overseen by hereditary guardians at this ancient sanctuary.

column3: The Possession of the Mask
column5: During the annual Indra Jatra festival, a human dancer donning a sacred wooden mask is overcome and possessed by the spirit of the ancient demon Lakhe.

column3: The Exorcism at Bigorski Monastery
column5: A young woman possessed by an unclean spirit after adopting a secular lifestyle found deliverance when she traveled to Bigorski Monastery to seek help from Saint John the Baptist. During the recitation of exorcism prayers before the monastery's wonder-working icon, the tormenting entity was successfully expelled.

column3: The Demonic Possessions of Santa Clara
column5: In 1674, between 23 and 26 nuns at the Santa Clara convent in Trujillo, Peru, suffered a terrifying wave of demonic possessions characterized by violent trances and supernatural visions. Despite prolonged exorcisms, the outbreak sparked widespread panic and drew the scrutiny of the Lima Inquisition.

column3: The Demonic Possession of Clarita Villanueva
column5: In May 1953, an incarcerated 17-year-old girl named Clarita Villanueva was allegedly attacked and possessed by invisible demonic entities inside her prison cell. Amid intense medical and media scrutiny, American evangelist Lester Sumrall performed a multi-day deliverance prayer session that culminated in the spirits' departure.

column3: The Demonic Dwarf of Wrocław
column5: An errant grandson, possessed by a malevolent demonic dwarf residing in a nearby church, savagely murdered his grandmother beneath the stone archway connecting two historic tenement houses.

column3: The Heart of the Moroi
column5: After a local pensioner died in an accident, his spirit allegedly possessed and began draining the life force of a young woman in the village, prompting a group of men to perform a midnight exhumation and ritual exorcism.

column3: The Mass Possession at Atauloma Girls School
column5: Eighteen students at a Samoan girls school suffered a violent mass spirit possession after trespassing in a sacred water hole near ancient star pyramids. The powerful entity hurled the girls off a bus while local pastors and families attempted in vain to intervene.

column3: The Possessed Cats of Suakin
column5: The feral cats roaming the crumbling coral ruins of Suakin are believed by locals to be physical vessels possessed by water-dwelling jinn. These mysterious felines inhabit the historic Red Sea port town as living manifestations of supernatural entities.

column3: The Possessions at Tanto Colin School
column5: Multiple students at a Surinamese high school were struck by sudden demonic possessions, experiencing violent trances, strange speech, and exhaustion. The outbreak prompted government intervention, psychiatric investigations, and cleansing rituals by religious leaders.

column3: The Demonic Possession and Healing of Cristina at Vadstena Abbey
column5: A newlywed peasant woman named Cristina was tormented and physically possessed by a demon that paralyzed her limbs and blinded her until she was cured at Vadstena Abbey.

column3: The Possession of Ban Songyae
column5: In 1908, multiple families in the northeastern Thai village of Ban Songyae fell victim to an outbreak of spirit possession by the cannibalistic Pop entity. The afflicted villagers were ultimately delivered when two Catholic priests intervened with religious rites at the village church.

column3: The Spiritual Awakening and Possession at Ahamb Church
column5: During a 2014 religious revival on the small island of Ahamb in Vanuatu, local children suddenly fell into trances and were possessed by spiritual entities, leading to intense spiritual warfare against hidden sorcery. Guided by these visions, villagers uncovered buried sorcery stones and animal remains outside their community hall.

column3: The Awakening at Ankaramalaza
column5: When a young Malagasy woman was compelled by an invisible force to intervene in a violent spirit possession, her successful exorcism sparked a nationwide revival.

column3: The Library Exorcism at a Banjarmasin High School
column5: Four female high school students were simultaneously possessed by an angered tree-dwelling spirit after campus branches were pruned. Staff members successfully performed Islamic exorcism rites to drive out the entities and restore the students.

column3: The Demonic Possession of Clara Germana Cele
column5: In 1906, a sixteen-year-old South African schoolgirl reportedly became possessed by a demonic entity after making a pact with Satan, exhibiting supernatural strength, levitation, and multilingual abilities before undergoing a solemn exorcism.

column3: The Jinni Hunter of Stone Town
column5: A traditional herbalist in Zanzibar investigates and expels malevolent spirits possessing locals and haunting historical ruins. During his work, he successfully extracts a tormenting jinni from a suffering woman by binding it with a Quranic contract.

column3: The Possession Outbreak at Moruga Composite School
column5: In 2010, multiple students at a secondary school in southern Trinidad experienced sudden, synchronized seizures and trance-like episodes that locals attributed to demonic possession. The dramatic flare-up resulted in school closures and drew visiting exorcists before being analyzed as a case of mass sociogenic illness.

column3: Drums in the Night: Amina and the Ancestral Spirits of Yoff
column5: A Lebu woman named Amina suffers years of distress after being inhabited by ancestral spirits known as rabs. Through traditional Ndöp possession ceremonies in Yoff, she eventually learns to integrate and coexist with the possessing entity rather than expel it.

column3: The Possessed Girl of Abaiang
column5: A thirteen-year-old girl in the Gilbert Islands became possessed by a malevolent ancestral spirit, exhibiting an unnaturally swollen abdomen and superhuman strength, until a missionary successfully performed an exorcism at the village church.

column3: The Oil Palm Apparitions of Kuala Lumpur Airport
column5: Malaysia's main international airport built on former oil palm fields is plagued by nighttime sightings and staff possessions.

column3: The Vengeful Spirits of Mount Popa
column5: Following their brutal execution by a suspicious king, a blacksmith and his sister became powerful animist spirits that possess mediums and guard the sacred mountain.

column3: The Exorcism Temple of Chougan
column5: Every Monday in the tribal village of Chougan, Madhya Pradesh, individuals believed to be possessed by malevolent spirits and demons are brought to a local temple to undergo exorcism rituals. Violent or aggressive subjects are secured within the temple's open-air enclosures while hereditary priests use sacred ash, tongs, and feather brooms to drive out the entities.

column3: The Queretaro Exorcism Chapel
column5: Faced with a rising surge of demonic possessions across Mexico, the Roman Catholic Church established a specialized facility dedicated entirely to performing exorcisms.

column3: The Jinn Possession and Exorcism in Zarqa
column5: A Jordanian businessman plagued by a female jinn named Johyna underwent recurring exorcism rituals in Zarqa to subdue the entity.

column3: The Chained Possession at the Ashabi Shrine
column5: An 18-year-old Pakistani youth experiencing violent fits attributed to jinn possession was brought by his family to a Sufi shrine, where he was chained by the ankle to a wall. His relatives sought spiritual exorcism after conventional medical remedies and hospital treatments failed to cure his condition.

column3: Haunting and Possession at Wilson Hall
column5: Wilson Hall at Ohio University is haunted by apparitions, voices, and objects moving, with a legend of a student suicide from demonic possession.

column3: The Haunting and Possession of Estefanía Gutiérrez Lázaro
column5: Following a disrupted school seance with a Ouija board, a teenage girl in Madrid began experiencing severe hallucinations and violent seizures before her mysterious death, after which her family's apartment became the site of documented paranormal disturbances and alleged demonic possession.

column3: The Exorcism of Anna Ecklund
column5: An American woman named Emma Schmidt, known under the pseudonym Anna Ecklund, endured a decades-long demonic possession that culminated in an intensive series of exorcisms at an Iowa convent in 1928. During the harrowing rituals, she reportedly levitated, spoke in languages she had never learned, and displayed violent physical reactions to holy objects.

column3: The Headless Bear of Ditcheat
column5: In 1584, a woman named Margaret Cooper possessed by the devil was haunted at her bedside by the terrifying apparition of a headless bear.

column3: Demonic Possession Reported in Saskatoon
column5: A Catholic priest was called to a Saskatoon home where a shirtless man with the word "Hell" carved on his chest claimed to be possessed by the devil.

column3: The Murder of Lorenzo Beha on the Tittleshall Road
column5: In November 1853, traveling watchmaker Lorenzo Beha was brutally murdered on the roadside between Wellingham and Tittleshall by local labourer William Thompson.

column3: The Legend of the Crostwight Flagon
column5: When a parish priest visited Crostwight Hall to complain about the lack of proper church furnishings, the lord of the manor characteristically poured wine and pushed the communion flagon across the table to him.

column3: The Wendigo at Bald Hill
column5: During a winter trapping camp in 1899 at Bald Hill, a trapper seized by terrifying windigo psychosis and threats of cannibalism was executed by his peers.

column3: The Exorcism of Barrancas
column5: A malicious demonic entity took complete possession of a local person in Venezuela, triggering a desperate nocturnal exorcism inside the church sacristy.
